title: Enhancing Border Controls and Extending Extra-territorial Provisions in Misuse of Drugs Act to Deter Smuggling of Vapes
what_it_is: Enhancing Border Controls and Extending Extra-territorial Provisions in Misuse of Drugs Act to Deter Smuggling of Vapes

sections.label: Vape smuggling interceptions and syndicate arrests
sections.summary: ICA intercepted 76 large-scale vape smuggling attempts at checkpoints and 57 via postal channels, and CNB arrested eight etomidate-vape syndicate members.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Between 15 September 2024 and 14 September 2025, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) intercepted 76 attempts of large-scale smuggling of vapes and related products at the checkpoints and 57 attempts through the postal channels.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: On 10 September, CNB dismantled a syndicate dealing in etomidate-laced vapes and arrested eight members of the syndicate.

sections.label: Etomidate overseas abuse provision
sections.summary: With etomidate and its analogues temporarily listed as Class C controlled drugs, the same provision applies to those who abuse etomidate overseas.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: With the temporary listing of etomidate and its analogues as Class C controlled drugs, the same provision will apply to those who abuse etomidate overseas.

sections.label: RTS operational response plan
sections.summary: An operational response plan is in place to enhance work at the RTS, addressing perceived gaps without inconveniencing travellers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As such, we have an operational response plan in place where we will enhance the way we do things at the RTS, looking at some of the perceived gaps and at the same time, we want to make sure that it does not inconvenience the travellers as much.

sections.label: Seizures and whole-of-Government effort
sections.summary: Authorities seized over 500,000 e-vaporisers and components, with whole-of-Government effort covering vapes, etomidate and other substances since 1 September.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Answering the second supplementary question first, during that period that I have shared, authorities have seized more than 500,000 e-vaporisers and related components across the cases that I have shared.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And what is key is that, as what was shared by Minister Ong Ye Kung earlier, we have the whole-of-Government effort.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: It is not only looking at vapes but also looking at etomidate and any other substances that may be brought into Singapore, since 1 September when we listed etomidate in Class C listing.

sections.label: Eight etomidate syndicate members arrested
sections.summary: Two weeks ago, eight members of etomidate syndicates were arrested.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Just two weeks ago, we arrested eight members of etomidate syndicates.

sections.label: E-vaporiser seizures in stated period
sections.summary: From 15 September 2024 to 14 September 2025, more than 3,000 e-vaporisers and related components were seized across these cases.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Member may be interested to note that during the period I shared, from 15 September 2024 to 14 September 2025, we have seized more than 3,000 e-vaporises and related components across these cases.

sections.label: Overseas Class C drug penalty
sections.summary: Consuming a Class C drug overseas still makes a person liable for penalty under the MDA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The first question, simple answer is, if you consume it overseas as a Class C drug, under MDA, you are still liable for penalty.

sections.label: Faster MOH legislation powers
sections.summary: MOH will propose new or amended legislation giving legal powers to act faster, including mandated rehabilitation and supervision, even without comprehensive clinical data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I just want to touch on the point that Mr de Souza raised earlier about being fast.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We are going to come to the House to propose a new legislation under MOH.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It can be new, or it can be an amendment of existing legislation, but it will provide us with the legal powers to act faster.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Even in the absence of total or of comprehensive clinical data on harm, on addiction, on dependence, we can take action first under MOH's powers with the collaboration of other agencies, to require mandated rehabilitation, mandated supervision.
